package.name: Storyboard
package.description: Plans still or animated Game and Roleplay storyboards with separate planning prompts and shared provider formatters. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Misc Agents/Storyboard for Roleplay and Game modes.

storyboard.name: Storyboard
storyboard.description: Plans still or animated Game and Roleplay storyboards with separate planning prompts and shared provider formatters. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Misc Agents/Storyboard for Roleplay and Game modes.

still-keyframes.name: Still Keyframes
still-keyframes.description: Game Mode storyboard preset for normal viewing. Creates single-scene keyframes and avoids comic text and panels.

novelai-keyframes.name: NovelAI Keyframes
novelai-keyframes.description: Game Mode storyboard preset with compact ASCII Danbooru tags tuned for NovelAI V4/V4.5 and native Add Character prompting.

comic-page-keyframes.name: Comic Page
comic-page-keyframes.description: Game Mode illustration preset with comic panels, dialogue, captions, and SFX.

colored-manga-keyframes.name: Colored Manga
colored-manga-keyframes.description: Game Mode storyboard preset with colored manga styling, panel-like staging, speech bubbles, and SFX.

bw-manga-keyframes.name: B&W Manga
bw-manga-keyframes.description: Game Mode storyboard preset with black-and-white manga inks, screentones, speech bubbles, and SFX.

still-keyframes-animation.name: Still Keyframe Animation
still-keyframes-animation.description: Plans one style-neutral first frame and one achievable continuous motion direction per clip.

anime-episode-director.name: Anime Episode Director
anime-episode-director.description: Plans broadcast-anime single shots with first-frame continuity, compact motion direction, and provider-safe staging.

novelai-keyframes-animation.name: NovelAI Keyframe Animation
novelai-keyframes-animation.description: Plans NovelAI V4/V4.5 tag-based first frames while keeping timing and motion in a separate animation direction.

comic-page-animation.name: Comic Page Animation
comic-page-animation.description: Plans duration-aware comic pages as ordered visual references for automatic animations.

colored-manga-keyframes-animation.name: Colored Manga Animation
colored-manga-keyframes-animation.description: Plans a text-free colored manga first frame with motion that preserves linework and cel shading.

bw-manga-keyframes-animation.name: B&W Manga Animation
bw-manga-keyframes-animation.description: Plans a text-free monochrome first frame with motion that preserves inks and screentones.

ltx-director-storyboard.name: LTX Director Storyboard
ltx-director-storyboard.description: Plans one first-frame illustration and one duration-aware LTX 2.3 image-to-video prompt for each shot.

ltx-simple-image-to-video.name: LTX Simple Image-to-Video
ltx-simple-image-to-video.description: Plans one first frame and one simple 4-8 sentence LTX 2.3 image-to-video prompt per shot.
